notes: Every Japanese car now has a shape for its model or era: kei cars and kei vans, Honda S500-S800, Beat, S660, del Sol, CR-Z, Insight, Ridgeline, Element, Nissan Figaro, Be-1, Pao, S-Cargo, Japanese pickups by cab size, Patrol and early Land Cruisers, 60s-90s Japanese coupés, plus saloons, hatches, estates, vans and SUVs by era.
